topic: RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) with std::lock_guard
explanation: RAII is a C++ programming idiom where resource management (such as locking a mutex) is tied to object lifetime. In this context, std::lock_guard is a class template that acquires a lock on a mutex upon construction and releases it upon destruction, ensuring exception-safe and scope-bound resource management. This pattern simplifies concurrent programming by automatically managing lock acquisition and release, preventing deadlocks and resource leaks.
